candidates.desc: A woman walks into a laundromat and finds her wet clothes thrown out of the machine onto the floor; she picks them up, then confronts the man who did it, glaring and shouting at him with a furious face.
A young woman sits alone on a row of waiting-room chairs under a wall clock. She fiddles with her keys, sighs, stares at the ceiling and slowly slumps sideways in her seat as the wait drags on.

A young woman with big round glasses sits among flat-pack furniture parts, turning a huge instruction sheet around, holding up two boards that clearly do not match, and finally shrugging at the wobbly half-built shelf, asking "What?".
A couple sits on a couch under a blanket watching a sad film; the woman cries and wipes her tears with tissues, the man tears up too, and they end up hugging and smiling through the tears.

In a crowded football fan pub, a woman watches a match with her hand pressed to her chest, going from nervous dread to closed-eyed tension. When the goal comes she erupts, screaming with joy and near tears as the whole bar celebrates around her.

A young woman in a green dress skips out of a shop and dances through a sunny Greek seaside street, laughing and greeting people, juggles a peach at a fruit stand, then sits by the harbor eating it and petting a dog, beaming the whole time.

A young woman stands barefoot on a harbor wall, shading her eyes and clasping her hands to her chest as she anxiously scans the sea; when a small fishing boat finally appears her worried face melts into joy and she throws her arms up.

A man in pajamas lies sprawled on a couch next to snacks and refuses to get up; instead of standing he grabs a broom to drag the TV remote closer, then stretches his whole body off the couch to reach it with his fingertips.

A teenage boy sets down his tray and eats a plate of peas all by himself in a huge empty school cafeteria. He looks around asking if anyone is there, answers himself that it is just him, and the wide shot shows rows and rows of empty tables around him.

A tearful woman in a green cardigan packs the books of her little bookshop into cardboard boxes, tapes one shut and looks around at the emptying shelves; overcome, she covers her mouth, hugs one last book to her chest and sinks to the floor crying among the boxes.

A hand-drawn animated calligrapher keeps a stern, focused face while two friends try everything to distract her - popping up with party hats, horns and spoons over their eyes; she never smiles, paints one perfect brush stroke, and stares them down while they wilt.
A woman with purple hair rides a night train: she yawns into her hands again and again, rubs her eyes, and slowly her head sinks against the window until she dozes off with a notebook on her lap.

In a 2D cartoon, a glum woman on a sunny ferry rests her chin on her hand while an old sailor beams at her; her frown slowly melts into a wide smile until the whole bench of passengers is smiling and laughing together.
On a rooftop terrace a man hands a woman a plain cardboard box; she opens it, gasps with her hands over her mouth, and lifts out a tiny puppy she was not expecting, hugging it with delight.
Two young women sit with coffees at a marble table in a busy cafe; one listens and grins while the blonde makes a big surprised face with her mouth open, and they both burst out laughing.

By a resort swimming pool at sunset, a woman in a short gold dress poses with one hand in her hair while a man in a white vest crouches down to photograph her with his phone. The camera closes in on her face and she smiles broadly at the lens, showing her teeth, with gold hoop earrings and palm trees behind her. The two of them then lean together over the phone to look at the photos, laughing, and she gives a thumbs up. In the last shot she walks back towards the pool and he lifts the phone to take another picture.

A stop-motion woolly sheep with a curly white fleece, a fluffy tuft on its head and an orange knitted scarf stands against a bright blue sky dotted with white clouds. It starts with a flat, bored face and heavy eyelids, then opens its mouth wide in a shout that shows its square teeth. Its face settles into a hard frown, the eyebrows pulled down over the eyes, and the camera pushes in until only the scowling face fills the screen.

Two small fluffy cartoon birds, one green and one blue, sit side by side on the shiny floor of a bright shop, eyes shut and bored. A tall pink bird with an enormous swept-up quiff struts past above them. Their eyes fly open and they follow her with a wide, dazzled stare, then turn to each other with a knowing, impressed look.

A shopping centre car park in bright sun. A white car has hit the rear side of a grey saloon, tearing a long crease through the wing and cracking the tail light, with black debris on the tarmac. An older woman in a light blue shirt grabs her head, shouts, and then keeps pointing and talking at the damage and at the young man beside her, while he crouches to photograph the torn panel with his phone and writes on a form propped on the other car's boot.

An office desk by a window. A young man in a knitted vest and glasses sits with his head bowed low over the desk, holding a wrapped bunch of white and yellow tulips; a large brown puddle of spilled coffee covers the laptop keyboard beside him. He sits up, grimaces at the mess and points at himself as he speaks, then mops the keyboard with a cloth. A woman colleague comes and stands over him with her arms folded; he bows deeply and holds the tulips up to her, and she takes them.

A woman in a bright multicoloured patterned jacket steps through an open front door carrying a tall stack of wrapped presents with big bows. Two children run at her in the hallway and she laughs down at them. She then holds the phone out for a selfie with a boy and a girl pressed to either cheek — all three have their eyes wide and their mouths open in a scream of delight. She dances through the living room with the children pulling at her hands. The last shot pulls back on a full birthday party: a ceiling of coloured balloons, guests dancing, and a birthday cake with lit candles surrounded by wrapped presents on the coffee table.

A young man with red hair in a green jumper stands at a living room window beside a packed wicker picnic basket. He gestures out at the street, where rain is running down the glass and the parked cars and brick houses are grey and wet. He drops a last apple into the basket, then lifts out the folded tartan blanket and hugs it against his chest, his face falling as he looks down. He turns away, sinks onto the arm of a chair by the radiator, and ends up slumped in the armchair with the blanket over his knees, chin on his hand, staring out at the wet street.

A group of teenagers crowd a phone held at arm's length in a bright classroom and take turns pulling faces into it. A girl with curly hair pushes her lips out in a fish pout and rolls her eyes sideways. A boy in glasses shoves his face right up to the lens, then grins with his mouth wide open. A girl with rainbow braids stares with her eyes stretched as wide as they go and her lips pushed forward. At the end the three of them squeeze their heads together and burst out laughing at the camera, mouths wide open, one of them showing her braces, while classmates work at the desks behind.

A woman in black sportswear at a trampoline park. She sits in a pit of red, blue, yellow and green foam cubes with her mouth wide open, laughing hard. She climbs out, walks along the ledge, then jumps back in and lands among the blocks, still laughing with her eyes screwed shut. At the end two women lie side by side in the foam pit laughing together.

A pale turquoise salt lake with bare desert hills behind it. A woman in an orange swimsuit and a wide straw sun hat lies on her back on the surface of the water, arms spread out, not sinking, with a yellow rubber duck bobbing at her shoulder. Behind her three more people lie on their backs in a row in the same way, two of them with their hands folded behind their heads and their eyes closed. The woman drifts, then opens a glossy magazine and holds it up above her face and reads it while she is still lying flat on the water, her feet sticking up at the front of the shot.

A teenager in a plaid shirt leaps down a flight of stone steps outside a big brick building with both arms flung wide and his mouth open in a shout. He vaults over a metal farm gate onto a country lane at golden hour. He rides a bicycle down an empty road through open fields with both hands off the bars and his arms stretched out to the sides. At the end he stands with the bike on a grassy hilltop above a wide valley, tips his head back to the setting sun and throws his arms open.

A busy hair salon. A stylist with long braids leans down and cups her hand to the ear of a client sitting under a leopard-print cape; the client's eyes go wide and her mouth drops open. The client is moved under a dome hair dryer and the two keep talking closely. Two women in the background stare with open mouths at a man having his hair clipped by a barber. At the salon's front desk a receptionist looks up from her computer with her mouth open, then the stylist is back beside the client under the dryer, both wide-eyed.

A man in a pale shirt sits in a leather armchair in a lobby with green plants and a small water feature behind him. An older woman in a uniform polo shirt stands behind the chair and kneads his shoulders and neck with both hands. His face goes from a tight grimace to a slack, blissful expression as he tips his head back with his eyes closed and smiles.

Inside a bright living room several young people burst into motion one after another. A woman throws off a grey blanket on the sofa with a huge grin, a man springs forward out of an orange armchair, another drops to the carpet and pumps out press-ups, and then the whole group jumps, high-fives, claps and cheers around the coffee table.

A young man with curly hair in an open cream shirt walks a whitewashed island street and lifts a pair of round dark sunglasses onto his face. He stops at a spinning rack of sunglasses outside a shop, tries on a pair of aviators, and then puts on enormous red heart-shaped sunglasses that cover half his face. He walks on to the harbour and poses proudly beside a blue and white fishing boat, pointing at himself while still wearing them.

A young man in a bright kitchen leans over a stainless-steel toaster and pushes the lever down. Two slices of toast pop up and he gasps with delight, then lifts them onto a white plate. He keeps going: slice after slice comes out of the toaster and he adds each one to the plate until the toast has grown into a tower far taller than the toaster itself. He grins over the top of the stack, buttering the topmost slice and reaching for still more.

A man wrapped in a thick checked blanket stands alone at the end of a wooden pier on a mountain lake, sipping slowly from a metal mug. Thick white mist hangs over the water at first; as it drifts away the turquoise lake, the pine forest and the snow-topped rock faces appear behind him, perfectly still and mirrored in the water. He keeps looking out, drinking, and nothing else moves.

Under a covered arcade with pastel green and pink walls, arches and glowing red paper lanterns at dusk, a young man in a dark bomber jacket and beige trousers stands with his eyes squeezed shut and his arms at his sides. A young woman in a blue jacket and black trousers rests her hands on his shoulder. He breathes out slowly through his mouth, tips his head back, then opens his eyes and stands calmly as she steps back. A cream-coloured scooter lies on its side on the tiled floor beside them.

A grassy hilltop at sunset with a view over a town and fields. A young woman in a light blue dress swings high and fast on a rope swing hanging from a big old oak tree, laughing with her head thrown back and her hair flying. Below on a blanket a young man in a white shirt sits cross-legged and eats chocolate cake with his eyes closed, enjoying every bite, while a brown and white spaniel jumps and runs around beside him. The light is warm, soft and golden.

A seaside promenade with colourful beach huts and a metal railing in soft morning light. A young woman with a long ponytail, in a blue jumper and white shorts, kneels on the pavement holding an empty cone and looking down with a sad face at her pink scoop of ice cream, which has fallen onto the ground. A seagull walks up and pecks at it. A young man in a rust T-shirt kneels beside her with his own cone, puts a hand on her shoulder and then hugs her.
